abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 1. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.
